actual_gain.docs:
The value of gain used for reported values. Particularly useful when gain is set to "auto".

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x29`. It is not possible to change this for this device without additional hardware. It also automatically uses a secondary address of `0x28` (see the datasheet), making that address unavailable for other devices on the same I²C bus.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

calculated_lux.docs:
The value of the calculated lux.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

device_factor.docs:
**float**: The default is `53.0`. The device factor to be used as part of the lux equation for `calculated_lux`.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

full_spectrum.docs:
The reading for the full spectrum sensor.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

gain.docs:
**string**: The gain the device will use. Higher values are better in low-light conditions. Multipliers here are approximate. Values below on the same line are aliases. You cannot specify an arbitrary gain multiplier. It must be one of:

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

glass_attenuation_factor.docs:
**float**: The default is `7.7`. The glass attenuation factor to be used as part of the lux equation for `calculated_lux`.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

infrared.docs:
The reading for the infrared sensor.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

integration_time.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time the device will use for each measurement. Longer means more accurate values. You cannot specify an arbitrary amount of time. It must be the equivalent of one of:

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: A user-friendly name for this TSL2591 device.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

power_save_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Should the device be powered down between update intervals? Defaults to `True`.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval for checking the sensors. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*

visible.docs:
The reading for visible light.

*See also: [TSL2591 Ambient Light Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tsl2591#configuration-variables)*
